signals.title: Fizzleberry Cola - 30 sec spot
signals.transcript: Crack open an ice cold Fizzleberry Cola. The fizz that fights the heat. Fizzleberry, pop the summer.

signals.title: Crunchwhirl cereal ad
signals.transcript: Hey kids! Crunchwhirl is the cereal that swirls! Part of this complete breakfast. Ask your parents for Crunchwhirl!

signals.title: Glimmerjack Robot holiday commercial
signals.transcript: This Christmas, give them Glimmerjack Robot, the toy that dances and lights up. Find it under the tree!

signals.title: Tundrix Trucks year-end sales event
signals.transcript: Come down to Harlow Tundrix, your hometown Tundrix dealer on Route 9. Zero down on every Tundrix pickup.

signals.title: Starwick Airways - fly further
signals.transcript: Starwick Airways. Nonstop to the islands, every day. Starwick, we fly further.

signals.title: Buckle Up public service announcement
signals.transcript: It only takes two seconds to buckle up. A message from the Highway Safety Council.

signals.title: We'll be right back bumper
signals.transcript: We'll be right back after these messages.

signals.title: Moonvault - in theaters Friday
signals.transcript: This summer, one vault holds the moon. Moonvault. Rated PG-13. In theaters Friday.

signals.title: Nibblet Bars trick or treat spot
signals.transcript: Trick or treat! Fill every bag with Nibblet Bars this Halloween. Spooky good chocolate.

signals.title: Penwright Supply back to school sale
signals.transcript: Backpacks, binders and notebooks, all half off. Get ready for back to school at Penwright Supply.

signals.title: Nightowl Roast coffee
signals.transcript: Long night ahead? Nightowl Roast. Dark coffee for the late shift.

signals.title: Clearbeam Wireless unlimited plan
signals.transcript: Unlimited talk and text on the Clearbeam Wireless network. Switch today and keep your number.

signals.description: Cartoon mascot Captain Crumb sails a cookie ship.
signals.title: Captain Crumb animated cookie commercial
signals.transcript: Ahoy! Captain Crumb cookies, baked for adventure!

signals.title: Marisol's Taqueria on Elm Street
signals.transcript: Family owned since the day we opened. Marisol's Taqueria, 400 Elm Street. Taco Tuesday every week.

signals.title: commercial break clip 14
signals.transcript: Now with more flavor than ever. Available wherever you shop.

signals.title: Classic running shoe ad
signals.transcript: Just lace up and go. The run starts now.

signals.title: Retro-looking cola ad, grainy film
signals.transcript: The taste you remember. Ice cold and bubbly.

signals.title: WKRX Channel 7 station identification
signals.transcript: You're watching WKRX, Channel 7, your home for local news.

signals.title: Coming up next on Channel 7
signals.transcript: Tonight at eight, an all new Harbor Lights. Only on Channel 7.

signals.title: Coldforge Lager - 21+
signals.transcript: Coldforge Lager. Brewed cold, poured colder. Please drink responsibly. Must be 21 or older.
